subject: female hair with a high ponytail, three-quarter front view (face only; the head underneath is a male test head, judge the hair)
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 (MHS3) anime toon style, Leia (official render)

silhouette.reference: Smooth rounded head of hair pulled back, a high ponytail rising just above the top at the back with a big purple ribbon bow on the image-right top; long locks frame the face down past the jaw on both sides with outward-curled ends.
silhouette.ours: Rounded head of hair with a short ponytail stub just above the top at the back and a smallish purple bow showing on the image-right top; straight locks frame the face down to about the jaw on both sides, ends pointed, not curled.

fringe.reference: Side-parted on the image left; long strands sweep from the part across the forehead toward the image right, the longest reaching the eye on the image right; thin strands fall beside the image-left eye.
fringe.ours: Parted on the image left; about seven pointed clumps fall over the forehead, the longest reaching the eyes on both sides, only a slight sweep toward the image right; forehead shows between the clumps.

sidelocks.reference: Long wispy face-framing locks from the temples down past the jaw to the neck, ends curling outward, a few loose strands.
sidelocks.ours: Two to three straight pointed locks per side from the temples down to about the jaw, ends straight, not curled outward.

ponytail.reference: High ponytail tied at the top back with a large purple ribbon bow (two loops), the tail rising a little then falling behind the head to the image right, full and wavy.
ponytail.ours: High ponytail tied at the top back with a purple bow (two flat loops, smaller than the reference's), the tail mostly hidden behind the head in this view; from the side it falls to the nape as a bundle of pointed clumps.

clumps.reference: Smooth hair with many fine strand lines, thin dark outlines, a few pale highlight streaks on the top front, soft warm shading.
clumps.ours: Fewer, bigger flat clumps with pointed tips and thin dark rim lines, pale highlight streaks across the top, flat light brown with a darker shadow side on the image right.
